_README: Recorded Facebook/Instagram exchanges, replayed so that anyone can run this project with no account of their own. Account identifiers are redacted to the last four characters; returned object ids are kept as returned. Replace these with your own recordings by running in --real mode with SAWT_RECORD=1.
